description: Beautifully remodeled 2 bedroom, 1 bath end unit offering single level living in the desirable Paradise Hills area. VA and FHA approved, making this an excellent opportunity for first time homebuyers, military buyers, and downsizers. This move in ready home features an open concept living and dining area that flows seamlessly to a private patio, creating the perfect indoor outdoor lifestyle. The updated kitchen includes new appliances, ample cabinetry, and pantry storage. Enjoy the convenience of an interior laundry area, central air conditioning, and quality finishes throughout. Enjoy two private patios. The main patio offers a comfortable outdoor entertaining space, while the second private patio is accessible directly from the primary bedroom, providing a peaceful retreat. As an end unit, the home offers added privacy in a quiet, well maintained community. Ideally situated approximately 15 minutes from Downtown San Diego, with easy access to Highway 54, Interstate 5, and Interstate 805, making commuting throughout San Diego County simple.

tagline: A private Covenant estate on 2.1 acres of lush grounds, blending Spanish Colonial architecture with contemporary luxury.
description: Exceptional custom craftsmanship meets modern luxury in one of San Diegos most coveted neighborhoods. Built in 2007 and extensively upgraded, this stunning 4-bedroom, 4-bath residence offers soaring ceilings, elegant travertine floors, multiple fireplaces, and a Viking chefs kitchen designed for everyday living and effortless entertaining. The west-facing view deck becomes your private front-row seat to colorful sunsets, Fourth of July fireworks, and peaceful evenings with peek-a-boo bay views. Just blocks away, enjoy Pioneer Parks summer concerts, the neighborhoods beloved Fourth of July parade, festive Halloween celebrations, and year-round community events that make Mission Hills one of San Diegos most desirable places to call home. Thoughtfully upgraded for comfort, efficiency, and peace of mind, the home features owned solar that has historically generated enough energy to power both A/C systems, charge an electric vehicle, and even produce a net SDG&E credit. Additional improvements include a newly restored and waterproofed west-facing deck, a Norman Woodlore motorized shutter accenting the grand front entry, Level 2 EV charging, heated bathroom vents, newer LG washer and dryer, a newer garage door and opener, and fruit-bearing avocado and lime trees. With no HOA or Mello-Roos, this rare newer custom home blends timeless architecture, exceptional quality, remarkable energy efficiency, and an unmatched Mission Hills lifestyle.

description_es: Artesanía personalizada excepcional combinada con lujo moderno en uno de los vecindarios más codiciados de San Diego. Construida en 2007 y ampliamente actualizada, esta impresionante residencia de 4 recámaras y 4 baños ofrece techos altos, elegantes pisos de travertino, múltiples chimeneas y una cocina Viking de chef diseñada para la vida cotidiana y el entretenimiento sin esfuerzo. La terraza orientada al oeste se convierte en su asiento preferencial privado para coloridas puestas de sol, los fuegos artificiales del 4 de julio y tranquilas noches con vistas a la bahía. A pocos pasos, disfrute de los conciertos de verano en Pioneer Park, el desfile del 4 de julio del vecindario, las celebraciones de Halloween y los eventos comunitarios que hacen de Mission Hills uno de los lugares más deseados para vivir en San Diego. Actualizada pensando en la comodidad, la eficiencia y la tranquilidad, la casa cuenta con paneles solares propios que históricamente han generado suficiente energía para ambos sistemas de A/C, cargar un vehículo eléctrico e incluso generar un crédito neto con SDG&E. Sin HOA ni Mello-Roos, esta excepcional casa personalizada combina arquitectura atemporal, calidad excepcional, eficiencia energética notable y un estilo de vida insuperable en Mission Hills.

description: Enjoy Gorgeous ocean view sunsets from this stunning two-story coastal retreat in the heart of Del Mar. Featuring 3 bedrooms and 3.5 bathrooms, this beautiful home is ideally located near the Del Mar Village, world-renowned beaches, Torrey Pines Reserve, premier shopping and dining, and top-rated schools. The light-filled living room showcases spectacular ocean views and opens to an expansive deck, creating the perfect indoor-outdoor living experience. The gourmet kitchen and dining area also enjoy sweeping blue-water views and feature chef-quality appliances, a large center island, and elegant finishes. Rich wood flooring flows throughout the home, complemented by sophisticated stone and tile accents. Experience the best of Southern California coastal living and make the Del Mar dream your reality.
description_es: Disfrute de impresionantes puestas de sol frente al mar desde este magnífico refugio costero de dos plantas en el corazón de Del Mar. Con 3 recámaras y 3.5 baños, esta hermosa casa está idealmente ubicada cerca del Del Mar Village, playas de renombre mundial, la Reserva de Torrey Pines, centros comerciales y restaurantes de primer nivel, y escuelas de alta calificación. La sala iluminada exhibe espectaculares vistas al océano y se abre a una amplia terraza, creando la experiencia perfecta de vida interior-exterior. La cocina gourmet y el área de comedor también disfrutan de vistas panorámicas al mar, con electrodomésticos de nivel chef, una gran isla central y acabados elegantes. Pisos de madera rica fluyen por toda la casa, complementados por sofisticados detalles de piedra y azulejo. Viva lo mejor de la vida costera del sur de California y haga realidad el sueño de Del Mar.

description: Perched in prestigious Del Mar Heights, this Masterfully reconstructed 5 bed, 5 bath residence of approximately 4,300 sq ft embodies elevated coastal luxury for the most discerning buyer. Every aspect has been thoughtfully renewed throughout this entire home renovation, from new windows, New plumbing, and electrical to smooth interior/exterior paint and European white oak wood flooring that sets a warm, sophisticated tone. The sculptural chef’s kitchen is anchored by Taj Mahal stone counters, massive island, white limestone wrapped pillars and feature wall, custom millwork, custom hood encompassed by Venetian plaster and a suite of Wolf and Zline appliances, flowing effortlessly into refined living and dining spaces oriented to capture tranquil ocean views. Designed for both intimate living and grand entertaining, the home offers a multimedia lounge, private gym, dry sauna, and a climate-controlled wine room. Walls of glass open to a resort-style backyard with a brand new pool, spa, porcelain pavers, and a fully equipped outdoor kitchen, creating a seamless indoor–outdoor experience. With designer finishes throughout and a flexible lower level designed for complete formal ADU, this is a rare opportunity to own a truly bespoke Del Mar estate. A true work of art!
description_es: Enclavada en las prestigiosas Del Mar Heights, esta magistralmente reconstruida residencia de 5 recámaras y 5 baños de aproximadamente 4,300 pies cuadrados encarna el lujo costero elevado. Cada aspecto fue cuidadosamente renovado: ventanas nuevas, plomería y electricidad nuevas, pintura interior/exterior lisa y pisos de roble blanco europeo que establecen un tono cálido y sofisticado. La escultural cocina de chef está anclada por encimeras de piedra Taj Mahal, una enorme isla central, columnas revestidas de piedra caliza blanca, carpintería personalizada, campana con yeso veneciano y electrodomésticos Wolf y Zline, fluyendo hacia refinadas áreas de sala y comedor con tranquilas vistas al océano. Diseñada para la vida íntima y el entretenimiento de gran escala, la casa ofrece sala multimedia, gimnasio privado, sauna seco y bodega con control climático. Paredes de vidrio se abren a un jardín resort con nueva piscina, spa, pisos de porcelana y cocina exterior totalmente equipada, creando una experiencia indoor-outdoor perfecta. Con acabados de diseñador y un nivel inferior flexible para ADU formal, esta es una oportunidad única de poseer una verdadera obra de arte en Del Mar.
